map.密码短语生成器。网络安全工具，专业计算，数据本地处理。: Generate memorable high-entropy passphrases from a word list, choosing the number of words and the separator, all locally.
map.用词序列替代弱口令（高熵好记）。: Replace weak passwords with a word sequence (high entropy, easy to remember).
map.为重要账户生成既好记又高强度的登录口令。: Generate memorable yet strong login credentials for important accounts.
map.4 词示例 `correct-horse-battery-staple`（熵远高: 4-word example `correct-horse-battery-staple` (far higher entropy than a random string of equal length).
map.词序列长度大、熵高且易记。: A word sequence is long, high in entropy and easy to memorise.
map.在常用词库下，4–6 个随机词通常即可达到 70 比特以上熵。: With a common word list, 4-6 random words usually reach 70+ bits of entropy.
map.口令强度用熵度量：n 为词数、W 为词表大小（如 7776 词）。叠加大小写变换: Strength is measured by entropy: n is the word count and W the word-list size (e.g. 7776 words). Case changes, digit and symbol substitution raise entropy further, but must be re-estimated against the actual option set.
Entropy (bit) = log₂(vocabulary size) × word count (the vocabulary has 170 words, about 7.41 bit per word); entropy is computed from vocabulary size × word count only, and the randomly inserted number (0–999) and symbol (one of !@#$%&*?+=) are not counted; the passphrase is the words joined by the separator, with optional manual options for initial capitalization or all caps. Validation: no strict validation, the word count is parsed as an integer. Criterion: the higher the entropy, the stronger the resistance to brute-force attacks; 4 words or more is recommended; the extra number/symbol mainly makes social-engineering dictionary matches harder.
